description:
Children Record is the first single of "Kagerou Project" by Shizen no Teki-P. This entry encompasses the 2 official music videos published on the Children Record DVD release.

Kisaragi Attention is the seventh song of the Kagerou Project series and also known as The story of snatching your eyes.

Children Record is the eighth song in the Kagerou Project series. It is considered the opening song of Kagerou Project and is also Jin's second most popular song.
